description: Four lines of evidence that urocanase deficiency is a largely benign biochemical phenotype
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(14,9))

# A. Expected vs observed cases: HW prediction from gnomAD vs reported patient count
ax=axes[0,0]
labels=["Predicted biallelic\npLoF individuals\n(gnomAD v4, world)","Reported patients\nin literature\nsince 1971"]
# 8.0e9 world population x 1/1,196,665
pred=8.0e9/1196665
obs=9
ax.bar([0,1],[pred,obs],color=["#2f6f6a","#9e2a2b"],width=0.5)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylim(1,2e4)
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=9)
for i,v in enumerate([pred,obs]): ax.text(i,v*1.25,f"{v:,.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel("individuals (log scale)")
ax.set_title("A. Predicted urocanase-null individuals exceed\nreported patients by ~740-fold",fontsize=11)

# B. Tissue expression (GTEx v8 median TPM)
ax=axes[0,1]
tis=["Liver","Kidney cortex","Small intestine","Pancreas","Brain (mean of 13)","Skin (sun exp.)"]
tpm=[62.0,1.49,0.52,0.21,0.122,0.019]
ax.barh(range(len(tis))[::-1],tpm,color=["#9e2a2b"]+["#6fa8a0"]*5)
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xlim(1e-2,2e2)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(tis))[::-1]); ax.set_yticklabels(tis,fontsize=9)
for i,v in zip(range(len(tis))[::-1],tpm): ax.text(v*1.3,i,f"{v:g}",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("median TPM (GTEx v8, log scale)")
ax.set_title("B. UROC1 is liver-restricted; brain expression is\n621-fold lower, so no brain-autonomous lesion",fontsize=11)

# C. IMPC Uroc1 knockout: significant vs tested parameters
ax=axes[1,0]
grp=["All IMPC\nparameters","Neuro-\nbehavioural","X-ray +\ngross path","Cardiac\n(echo+ECG)","Haematology\n+ metabolic"]
tested=[330,137,64,23,23]; sig=[2,1,0,0,0]
x=np.arange(len(grp))
ax.bar(x-0.18,tested,width=0.36,color="#c8ccd0",label="tested")
ax.bar(x+0.18,sig,width=0.36,color="#9e2a2b",label="significant")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(grp,fontsize=8.5)
for i,(t,s) in enumerate(zip(tested,sig)):
    ax.text(i-0.18,t+6,str(t),ha="center",fontsize=9); ax.text(i+0.18,s+6,str(s),ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("number of parameters"); ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("C. Uroc1-null mice: 2 of 330 parameters significant,\nviable and fertile, no ataxia or gait defect",fontsize=11)

# D. Four-gene pathway constraint
ax=axes[1,1]
g=["HAL\n(step 1)","UROC1\n(step 2)","AMDHD1\n(step 3)","FTCD\n(step 4)"]
oe=[1.048,0.882,1.020,1.209]; up=[1.255,1.064,1.307,1.463]; hom=[5,8,0,24]
x=np.arange(4)
ax.errorbar(x,oe,yerr=[[0]*4,[u-o for u,o in zip(up,oe)]],fmt="o",ms=9,color="#2f6f6a",capsize=6,lw=2)
ax.axhline(1.0,ls="--",color="#9e2a2b",lw=1.5)
ax.text(3.35,1.01,"no constraint",color="#9e2a2b",fontsize=9,va="bottom",ha="right")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(g,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylim(0.6,1.6)
ax.set_ylabel("observed / expected pLoF (90% CI upper)")
for i,h in enumerate(hom): ax.text(i,0.66,f"{h} pLoF\nhomozygotes",ha="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title("D. No enzyme of the histidine degradation module\nis under loss-of-function constraint",fontsize=11)

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
